title:
It's not a bug.
It's not a network error.
It is, as always, DNS.
subtitle: You updated the A record 14 minutes ago with a TTL of 86,400 seconds. Some recursive resolver in New Zealand has cached your old IP address until the heat death of our sun.
logs: > it was DNS. It is always DNS. It will always be DNS.
footnote: Error code: `ALWAYS-DNS-404` · Root cause: DNS · Blame: DNS · Future outages: DNS
